subject: Au contraire.....
author: rumblefish
body: Ah, but I do have a 360 in the house (actually belongs to my son - the Playstations have always been mine), just haven't played with it much. Wasn't aware there were any Burnout games for the 360, though. Will have to check them out, and thanks for the recommendation!

subject: Other Burnout games...
author: FrozenVapor
body: Burnout 3 and 360 Revenge are the best games in the series for pure racing action IMO. I imagine you don't have a 360, so just get your hands on Burnout 3 - it's definitely worth it.
